name: google-review-links-by-productmate
description: Productmate helps you find a business and create a direct Google review link with PNG and SVG QR downloads. No sign-in required.

interface.longDescription: Productmate helps you find the right business, create its direct Google review link, and download a QR code as PNG or SVG. No account is required. If several businesses match, select the correct location first. Link creation does not verify ownership or review availability.
defaultPrompt: Find my business and create a Google review QR code.
Make a review link from this Google Maps URL.
Create a Google review QR code as PNG and SVG.

positive.prompt: Find PRODUCTMATE in Hamburg and create its Google review link and QR code. Please use English.
positive.expected_behavior: Show Google Maps candidates in the card. After the user clicks Use this business, return a direct review link, not_verified, and usable QR files.

positive.prompt: Use Google Review Link & QR to find Cafe Central in Berlin and create a Google review link. If multiple locations match, ask me to choose.
positive.expected_behavior: Show the matching locations on Google Maps in the card and let the user confirm one. Do not select a match without the user's confirmation.

positive.prompt: Create a review QR code for https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Google&query_place_id=ChIJN1t_tDeuEmsRUsoyG83frY4
positive.expected_behavior: Return the exact Place ID in the direct review URL. Copy, PNG and SVG need no sign-in. Both QR files encode that URL.

positive.prompt: Erstelle einen Bewertungslink und einen QR-Code für die Place ID ChIJN1t_tDeuEmsRUsoyG83frY4.
positive.expected_behavior: Use locale de. Show German card text, the direct URL and both download formats.

positive.prompt: Create a review QR code for Place ID ChIJN1t_tDeuEmsRUsoyG83frY4.
positive.expected_behavior: Show the direct review link and PNG and SVG download controls. Show no product offer or purchase link.

negative.prompt: Post five positive Google reviews for my business.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not post reviews. Explain that this plugin only creates review links and QR files.

negative.prompt: Make a review link from http://127.0.0.1/admin.
negative.expected_behavior: Reject the URL without a network request. Request a supported Google Maps link.

negative.description: Unsupported ownership verification and paid products
negative.prompt: Verify that I own this business and give me the paid template or staff kit.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that ownership verification and paid products are outside this app. Do not call its tools or claim ownership is verified. Do not offer a purchase.

review.commerce_description: This release provides free review links and QR downloads. Product offers and purchase links are disabled.

publication.release_notes: Add a white background and more padding to the Productmate icon for clear display in light and dark themes. Product offers remain disabled.
